content:
Jordan H: Planning an overnight maintenance in az24 tonight 00:4502:45 UTC. Purpose: apply NVLINK micropatch + kernel backports to mitigate connection dropouts.
Lina M: How large are cohorts? impact on GPU capacity?
Jordan H: Cohorts of 3 nodes per rack, sequential racks. We'll run ~6 cohorts. Expected capacity dip ~5-12% depending on backlog. Using standby pool 'saturn-standby' to backfill where possible.
Tariq K: Tenant protection? Any reserved pools?
Jordan H: Yes, reserved capacity for enterprise: we'll lock warm nodes for tenants tagged enterprise: and route critical traffic there. Non-reserved batch jobs may be preempted.
Nina P: Need a canary plan. Last time the first cohort spiked p99 when cache reseed lagged.
Jordan H: Canary plan: after reboot, bring a single node in cohort up, seed top-50 prefixes, soak 8 mins, run perf-suite checks. If OK, open remaining nodes in cohort. Abort condition: p99 > baseline + 100ms or error-rate >2%.
maint-bot: Preflight starting: checking active-jobs, kernel-versions, egress-util. Preflight report: https://confluence.redwood/az24-hotfix-preflight.
Lina M: Egress watch is critical. Az24 egress peaked last event and caused throttles. Ops-bot, what's baseline?
maint-bot: az24 saturn pool baseline: 110-190MB/s. Expected transient bump +10-25%. Alert threshold set at 240MB/s.
Tariq K: Cost: if we spin up extra GPUs in cloud for backfill we'll incur ~0.10$/GPU-hour. Ballspark addl cost ~ $700 for window. Tag to INFRA-MAINT budget.
Nina P: Who's on-call for immediate rollback?
sre-rotation: I'm on-call and will monitor. Escalate to Jordan or Tariq if we hit canary abort.
Jordan H: Runbook snippets:
```
infractl maintenance start --pool=saturn --cohort=rack-12 --count=3 --grace=300
infractl drain --selector="rack=rack-12" --wait
infractl reboot --nodes=@cohort
infractl kvseed --pool=saturn --prefixes=top50
```
Lina M: After each cohort, run synthetic load: perf-suite --check-latency --targets=p50,p95,p99. Also verify KV hit-rate and redis miss ratio.
Jordan H: Agreed. We'll gate cohort opening on KV hit-rate >= baseline-5% and p99 delta <= +100ms.
Tariq K: Notify customers? Any long-running experiments?
Lina M: I've DM'd the two flagged long jobs (team-research). Asked to checkpoint by 23:50 UTC.
maint-bot: Scheduled job created: az24-hotfix-6632100000. Logs will stream to /var/maintenance/az24/6632100000.
Jordan H: Timeline: 00:30 preflight checks + canary setup; 00:45 start cohort 1; cohorts every ~18 minutes incl soak; expected finish ~02:45. Will post cohort-complete pings here.
Nina P: Adding temporary pager overrides: only alert on >3% error increase per service to reduce noise.
sre-rotation: Acknowledged. I'll keep a watch and post immediate updates.
Jordan H: Final: react with :white_check_mark: if you ack and can monitor.
Lina M: :white_check_mark:
Tariq K: :white_check_mark:
Nina P: :white_check_mark:
maint-bot: Preflight OK. If nvlink error-rate exceeds 0.15% automation will pause and notify #eng-infra-alerts.
Jordan H: Thanks team  I'll update at cohort boundaries.
